plain_english_policy: This bill is a **state funding and accountability measure** for the Coalition Against Domestic Violence (CADV) in Alabama. It does not create new programs or policies but instead **enhances oversight of an existing entity** by tying state funds to transparency requirements. The policy direction would be:
policy_direction_if_enacted: **Increased financial accountability and performance reporting for domestic violence services**
evidence_quotes: To make an appropriation of **$435,600** from the State General Fund to the Coalition Against Domestic Violence...
Prior to the release of any funds... an **operations plan and an audited financial statement** must be forwarded to the Director of Finance.
Quarterly reports for fiscal year 2010-2011 shall be made to the Director of Finance relating actual expenditures and accomplishments.
review_reason: The bill is clear in its intent: it funds CADV ($435,600) but only after they submit an operations plan + audited financials for prior years. Quarterly/annual reports are mandatory to track spending and outcomes. No ambiguity or ceremonial language.
